# Support

**Questions go to [Discussions](https://github.com/project-fusion/fusion/discussions).**
Issues are for a defect or a proposal, and a question filed as either tends to
sit waiting for a reproduction that was never the point.

Worth reading first, because they answer most of it:

- [Installation](https://helix.fusion.dev/docs/installation) and
  [Introduction](https://helix.fusion.dev/docs/introduction)
- [Using the elements](https://helix.fusion.dev/docs/using-the-elements), which
  is the page most first questions turn out to be about
- [Theming](https://helix.fusion.dev/docs/theming) and
  [Tokens](https://helix.fusion.dev/docs/tokens)
- The [component gallery](https://helix.fusion.dev/components), where every
  family has a live example

**If it is a defect**, open an [issue](https://github.com/project-fusion/fusion/issues/new/choose).
**If it is a vulnerability**, do not open an issue: use
[private reporting](https://github.com/project-fusion/fusion/security/advisories/new),
which is the only channel that does not tell everyone else first.

We are a small team and we would rather answer once in public than three times in
private, which is why the answer is Discussions rather than an address.
